name: PVC (suspension) and chlor-alkali
principle: Chlor-alkali electrolysis makes chlorine, caustic soda and hydrogen from brine. Chlorine and ethylene give EDC by direct chlorination and oxychlorination; cracking EDC at about 480 degC gives vinyl chloride monomer, which is polymerised in suspension to PVC. thyssenkrupp nucera quotes less than 1,960 kWh per tonne NaOH for its membrane cells at 6 kA/m2.
